rows.note: Use this as the general choice for someone who is attractive or good-looking, especially when the sexy nuance is not central.

example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 joeng2 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this when “dreamy” specifically highlights someone’s sex appeal rather than just their good looks.

example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 go3 joeng2 zan1 hai6 hou2 sok3

rows.note: Use this for a place, occasion, or atmosphere that feels pleasantly romantic.

example.english: This restaurant feels really dreamy at night.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 je6 maan5 hou2 long6 maan6

rows.note: Use this for something that resembles a dream or has a fantastical, unreal quality.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 coeng4 ging2 zan1 hai6 hou2 mung6 waan6
